hook: Artificial intelligence automates 50 percent of work hours, yet employers rank it 14th in priority.

sections.voiceover: Artificial intelligence automates 50 percent of work hours, yet employers rank it 14th in priority.
b_roll: Digital graphs showing work hour automation percentages
A corporate ranking list highlighting AI in fourteenth place

text_overlay.text: AI automates half of all work hours

sections.voiceover: Purdue University published findings on October 9, 2026, revealing what hiring managers actually want. McKinsey research shows tech handles half of U.S. work hours. Which skill beats algorithms for business school graduates?
b_roll: Purdue University campus buildings and digital research archives
McKinsey global workplace reports on automated tasks
Business school graduates reviewing corporate recruitment surveys

sections.voiceover: Yet McKinsey's data shows AI tool usage ranks a distant fourteenth in recruiter priority.
b_roll: GMAC corporate recruiter survey documents open on a desk

sections.voiceover: Sixty-four percent named communication as their top demand. Problem-solving followed closely at 62 percent. Adaptability secured 60 percent among corporate recruiters.
b_roll: Data charts displaying communication at 64 percent
Bar graphs comparing problem-solving and adaptability metrics

sections.voiceover: Communication outranks using AI tools, which employers ranked 14th in priority.
b_roll: Executive boardrooms discussing human skills in 2026
Purdue University research reports on communication
